weather.label: Weather

lead.hed: USNI: George Washington is in CENTCOM. A carrier move is not a new war.
lead.insight: USNI, Thursday: USS George Washington (CVN-73) arrived in the U.S. Central Command area yesterday, CENTCOM said. Cruiser USS Robert Smalls (CG-62) and destroyer USS Shoup (DDG-86) are with her; the group transited the Arabian Sea Thursday. Presence is not a strike order. A hull in the AOR is not a campaign.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo by Chief Mass Communication Specialist Joshua Karsten · DVIDS 9878095 · PUBLIC DOMAIN · EA-18G Growler launches from USS George Washington (CVN-73), Indian Ocean, Aug. 18, 2026
lead.image_note: Official U.S. Navy DVIDS still of CVN-73 two days before the CENTCOM arrival note. Indian Ocean, Aug. 18 — not a Thursday Arabian Sea still, not a brand tile. Caption must say Aug. 18 flight ops, not today's AOR announcement.

political.hed: WORLD: Trump says a Canada tariff deal. Nothing is signed. Friday night is still the clock.
political.insight: WORLD Radio, Thursday: Trump said the U.S. and Canada have a deal to delay tariffs. The White House says nothing is signed. Canada’s trade minister says dairy protections came through intact. A podium line is not a signed annex. Friday night is still the clock.

political.hed: Law & Liberty: Portland’s climate fund is not a police car.
political.insight: Law & Liberty, Thursday: Portland’s Clean Energy Fund, sold as a $30 million climate surcharge, has raised about $1 billion while roads, 911, and shelters lag. A former City Hall aide says white luxury beliefs, not minority neighborhoods, keep the money off core order. A ballot climate pot is not a patrol shift.

political.hed: WORLD: A former Fauci adviser pleaded guilty. A plea is not a Fauci verdict.
political.insight: WORLD Radio, Thursday: David Morens pleaded guilty to felony conspiracy for moving official COVID-origin business to private Gmail to dodge records requests. Four other counts dropped. Sentencing in November. Fauci was not charged here and remains under the Biden pardon. A plea is not a lab finding.

tech.hed: State cleared a possible $4.5 billion KC-46A sale to Qatar. A notice is not a tanker on the ramp.
tech.insight: Defense News / State, Thursday: possible FMS of up to four KC-46As, engines, and LAIRCM gear, estimated $4.5 billion. Boeing, Pratt, RTX, Northrop named. No extra U.S. reps required in Qatar, State says. A congressional notice is not a signed delivery. Approval is not iron on the ramp.

tech.hed: USNI posts the White House science-and-tech strategy. A PDF is not a fielded system.
tech.insight: USNI, Thursday: the White House National Security Science and Technology Strategy, released earlier this week, is meant to back the 2025 National Security Strategy. A posted strategy is not a budget line. Paper is not a ship or a sensor.

tech.hed: USNI: Marines just ran an attack-drone meet at Quantico. A contest is not a fielded fireteam.
tech.insight: USNI, Wednesday: the Marine Corps wrapped the inaugural Attack Drone Competition at Quantico on Friday, after a summer of drone firsts in Korea and Australia. A range meet is not a TO&E change. Training is not a deployed squadron.

watch.hed: WATCH: Ulchi Freedom Shield still ends Friday. A shorter drill is not a new treaty.
watch.insight: Defense News Wednesday, still the file Thursday: allies cut Ulchi Freedom Shield from 11 days to five — ends Friday, Aug. 21, not Aug. 27. Some live events cancelled or moved to simulations. Kim Yo Jong still calls it provocative. A shorter calendar is not a treaty rewrite.

watch.hed: WATCH: Navy charged a Kennedy sailor in a shipmate’s death. A charge is not a verdict.
watch.insight: USNI, Wednesday: the Navy charged Aviation Boatswain’s Mate Airman Apprentice Jayjrion Rodriguez with murder, involuntary manslaughter, and assault in the death of a boatswain’s mate aboard John F. Kennedy (CVN-79). A charge sheet is not a court-martial finding.

watch.hed: WATCH: Benfold’s four-day blackout is still under investigation.
watch.insight: Defense News, Wednesday, wrapping the USNI file: USS Benfold (DDG-65) lost power four days in the South China Sea in July, was towed to Subic, and left Aug. 8 with systems up. 7th Fleet says the mishap is under investigation. Underway again is not a closed engineering report.
